rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before real data; synthetic validation at real counts with veteran-calibrated variance (two biased estimators found and replaced, P1 calibrated); 19 replication joins; three natives (one void: NE32 did not happen as catalogued); both embedding models and four variants; scorecard; frozen, guarded confirm script dry-run, not run. Low power limits what more of the same design can show; round 2 needs a convention-based design.
rationale.faithfulness: The enculturation model is not supported and not refuted: the pooled index does not beat the calibrated null in either model (bge +0.020, gte -0.011) at power 0.15-0.30. The family signature at entry (13/15, both models) and immediate room alignment are real but are not the hypothesised slow convergence. Scorecard A1 B1 C0 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Gives an operator two computable facts: newcomers match the day's conversation from day 2 (gap -0.02, closing to 0), and they align with the room they are placed in at once (0.18, as veterans). No induction period or reading quota is indicated. The village-culture question stays open.

one_line: Newcomers match the village's conversation from day 2 (gap -0.02) and lose a first-week family signature (K_E +0.038, 13/15); no slower enculturation is detectable (Delta G +0.020 bge, -0.011 gte; power <= 0.3).

models.note: No detectable relaxation of newcomer constants; low power
Room alignment immediate; no dose response

v2.claim: Newcomers match the village's day-to-day content from tenure day 2 (gap to the veteran centroid −0.020 [−0.056, +0.020], ≈ 0 by days 8–14) and carry a first-week family signature that fades (K_E +0.038, 13/15 joins); slower enculturation into a persistent culture is not detectable (power ≤ 0.3)
v2.scope: 19 joins, 15 join days, three regimes; natives G38, NE27 (NE32 premise false)
